A CLEARLY DEFINED SCOPE

Start with the right details.

Street lighting installation for roads, communities and public spaces in Dubai and the UAE, with coordinated poles, luminaires and controls. Each package is reviewed against the project drawings, specifications and site conditions.

  • Review of lighting layouts, site conditions and installation requirements
  • Pole foundations, erection and luminaire installation

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions.
Considered.

A practical starting point for your street lighting enquiry.

What information is useful for a street lighting quotation?

Provide the site location, lighting layout, pole and luminaire specifications, quantities, available electrical supply and proposed programme. Include a bill of quantities if one is available, plus any access restrictions or interfaces with other contractors.

Can the scope cover both new roads and existing developments?

New installations and upgrades have different requirements. For an existing development, the condition of the poles, foundations, cabling and controls needs to be understood before defining what can be retained or replaced.

What should be included in a lighting handover?

Agree the deliverables at the start of the project. Depending on the contract, these may include inspection and test records, as-built drawings, equipment information and a maintenance schedule.
